temporal_semantics.as_known_at_cutoff: Events whose transaction_time is less than or equal to cutoff_unix. This answers what was recorded/available by that cutoff.
temporal_semantics.authority_as_known_at_action: Authority grant/revocation facts recorded no later than action_time_unix, then evaluated against valid-time interval and exact decision/principal/target binding.
temporal_semantics.authority_current_assessment: All currently recorded grant/revocation evidence relevant to action_time_unix, including late-recorded retroactive facts. This may differ from authority_as_known_at_action; neither view rewrites the other.
temporal_semantics.outcome: Executor attempt status is not an observed outcome. Only EffectObservation events linked to the exact attempt count, and each must identify an observer_ref distinct from the attempt's issuer_ref. Same-source observation yields INDEPENDENCE_UNESTABLISHED, not confirmation.
temporal_semantics.challenge: An open challenge remains visible even when a later resolution exists; resolution does not delete the historical challenge.
temporal_semantics.supersession: Decision successors are explicit through supersedes_ref; predecessors remain in the event history.
temporal_semantics.privacy: Protected payload disclosure is a separate projection violation. A digest does not reveal or authenticate the underlying protected content.
temporal_semantics.remedy_order: A RemedyOrder is a versioned institutional order linked to the challenged Decision and Challenge. Its issuer must hold an exact AuthorityGrant scoped to the RemedyOrder subject, principal and target at order time.
temporal_semantics.remedy_execution: A RemedyOrder is not a completed remedy. It is complete only when its exact Attempt has an EffectObservation from an observer identity distinct from the Attempt issuer. Partial, contradicted, contested, same-source and unobserved states remain distinct.
temporal_semantics.systemic_action: A CorrectiveAction remains Open, Verified or Ineffective. A Verified claim whose observer_ref is NONE or equals the issuer_ref is reported as INDEPENDENCE_UNESTABLISHED. A status label or policy update alone is not evidence of non-repetition.

non_compensable_rules: No post-cutoff event may enter the as-known-at-cutoff set.
No later correction or supersession rewrites earlier event bytes or historical knowledge.
Executor success is not an independent outcome observation.
Unknown, contradictory and incomplete states remain typed.
No protected payload is exposed by the audit projection without an explicitly authorized disclosure profile.
An EffectObservation without a distinct observer identity from the exact Attempt issuer cannot establish an independent outcome.
A RemedyOrder does not imply an executed or completed remedy.
Remedy authority is checked against a grant scoped to the exact remedy order, reviewer and target at order time.
Late, retroactive revocation changes current remedy-authority reassessment without rewriting as-known-at-order.
A remedy attempt requires an independent EffectObservation to qualify as completed.
Partial, contradicted, contested, same-source and unobserved remedy outcomes are not completed.
CorrectiveAction status is reported separately from individual remedy completion.
A systemic corrective action is not VERIFIED when its observer identity equals its issuer identity.
claim_ceiling: Synthetic temporal reconstruction, authority-as-known/current, decision/outcome/contestability, remedy-order authority, remedy execution/observation and independent corrective-action observation only. No legal, substantive-remedy-adequacy, institutional legitimacy, empirical truth or production readiness claim.
